notes: Adapter/converter (QSFP28 host to SFP28/SFP+/SFP receptacle); RF channel of SFP28 connected to lane 1 of QSFP28 only; three remaining QSFP28 RF channels not connected. Operating temperature 0°C to +70°C; storage -40°C to +85°C. Power stated as <0.3W. I2C read of SFP28 registers via QSFP28 management SFF-8636. Ordering: 10G channel from SFP28 to lane 1 on QSFP28 with DDMI support. Brand website smartoptics.com referenced but manufacturer name not explicitly stated in body text.
suggestions: This product is a mechanical/electrical adapter rather than an optical transceiver; many optical and FEC fields are appropriately null. Consider a separate schema or product_type field for converters/cables vs modules.
